scope_note: This chronology is specific to Sikolohiyang Pilipino and must not be generalized into the origin date of all indigenous psychologies.
statement: Pe-Pua locates the seeds of Filipino indigenous research methods in the early 1970s Sikolohiyang Pilipino movement led by Virgilio Enriquez.
statement_zh: Pe-Pua 將菲律賓本土研究方法的萌芽置於 1970 年代初由 Virgilio Enriquez 推動的 Sikolohiyang Pilipino 運動。
